summary: Pre-market brief for 2026-10-21, built on the 11:08Z fact layer. Session attribution first: the US leg is the 2026-10-20 settled close, because every US 1-year series and every quote ends on that bar; the Asian leg is the 2026-10-21 session that has already finished, with A-shares closing 9 up and 2 down of 11 at a mean gain of 2.0922 percent, Korea's two memory names up 5.8054 and 5.6738 percent, Hong Kong's 1810.HK down 0.9608 percent and Taiwan's 2317.TW up 3.5197 percent. Composite risk is 61.15, level high_risk, regime late_cycle, up 3.71 cross-session from 57.44 on 2026-10-20, with trend_1w at 8.1 and trend_1m at 12.29. Two things must be said about that 3.71 immediately. First, it is almost entirely one leg: cross_asset_confirmation moved from 0.375 in the 2026-10-20 post-market layer to 0.625, which is 5 of the 8 production signals, and at a 0.15 weight each additional signal is worth 1.875 points, so that leg contributes 3.75 while the other five dimensions moved by 0.002, 0.048 and 0.009, the last two being effectively zero. Second, nothing in the price structure deteriorated: VIX is 18.44 against 19.99 previously, realized volatility is 9.0226 and the volatility dimension at 34.46 is the lowest of the six. What flipped two binary signals was the commodity tape, copper turning negative at 0.1827 percent down and gold turning positive at 0.0459 percent up, and a signal count is not a stress reading. The regime label changed too, from risk_on to late_cycle, on the rule that cross-asset 0.625 is at or above 0.55 while VIX 18.44 is at or above 18. The overnight information flow was concentrated in one company's supply chain rather than in macro: NVIDIA announced industrial-simulation acceleration of up to 40 times, a 64GB DGX Spark from 4999 US dollars starting 2026-10-23, Vera Rubin NVL72 A5X instances on Google Cloud opening next month, substrate capacity lifted to 2.5 times over three years with six partners, an Isaac humanoid reference framework and a clinical surgical simulator; Samsung Electro-Mechanics joined the substrate supply chain, and Mercedes-Benz and Audi are named as industrial-AI adopters. None of it moved Nvidia itself, which closed the 2026-10-20 session at 216.470001, down 0.2856 percent and down 5.2731 percent on the week; Broadcom at 334.369995 down 0.0658 percent, Micron at 896.070007 down 0.9758 percent and AMD at 534.73999 down 0.6152 percent and down 11.6906 percent on the week. The 22-row sector table shows the AI-application side leading and the semiconductor chain lagging: semiconductor_equipment down 1.4039 percent, semis down 0.4856 percent, data_centers down 0.4239 percent, semiconductors down 0.3825 percent and industrial_automation down 0.1536 percent, against autonomous_driving up 2.2694 percent, quantum_computing up 1.8537 percent and ai_software up 1.7919 percent; 16 rows rose, 6 fell, and the mean is 0.9395 percent. The largest single row, memory at 5.7396 percent, must not be read as a US theme move: its effective basket is 8 names, the 6 US constituents have no 2026-10-21 bar, and the published value is the mean of the two Korean constituents alone; the same form applies to consumer_electronics at 1.2794 percent, Hong Kong and Taiwan only, and robotics at 0.0617 percent down, 6861.T alone. Tesla closed at 373.709991, up 1.5351 percent but still down 0.4051 percent on the week, and it reports at 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z alongside META and T with a forecast of 0.4488, in the same slot where SpaceX's third quarter, revenue growth 161 percent and adjusted EBITDA growth 306 percent, plus Musk calling a SpaceX-Tesla merger a good idea, left SpaceX up more than 8 percent in premarket. Underneath all of this, breadth is still the weak spot: 0.4 above the 200-day average, 62 of 155, with 6 new highs against 10 new lows, small_cap_relative 9.0256 percent behind and semis_relative 12.8878 percent behind. On the macro side the binding caveat is vintage: the 10-year at 5.15 and the 2-year at 4.77 are the 2026-10-19 prints, high yield OAS at 3.29 and investment grade at 0.87 are also the 2026-10-19 prints, breakevens at 2.31 and 2.35 and reverse repo at 0.227 are the 2026-10-20 prints, the Fed balance sheet at 6755639.0 is the 2026-10-14 print, the dollar index at 121.4048 is the 2026-10-16 print, core PCE at 3.0076 is still the 2026-08-01 print and core CPI at 2.56584 is the 2026-09-01 print, so the 61.15 is built on a rates block that lags the equity leg and lags the commodity leg further. Confidence is 0.9153 with data quality 1.0, coverage 0.93 and consistency 0.7163; all 7 input datasets are fresh.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.625, contribution 9.375 points, is the largest single driver today and the entire source of 61.15 against 57.44: the ratio rose from 0.375 in the 2026-10-20 post-market layer to 5 of the 8 production signals, and each additional signal is worth 1.875 points at a 0.15 weight. What drove it was not equity but two binary commodity flips, copper turning negative at 0.1827 percent down and gold turning positive at 0.0459 percent up, so this is a count change, not a risk repricing.

High yield OAS at 3.29, contribution 6.4384 points, is the largest item in the credit leg at the 80.48 percentile; but the print is 2026-10-19 and it is 0.02 tighter than the previous 3.31, which points the other way from the risk score — it raises the score because the level is high, not because credit is deteriorating.

The 10-year real rate at 2.8, contribution 4.944 points, sits at the 98.88 percentile, up 0.06 from the previous 2.74, and is the most direct valuation pressure inside a macro dimension of 73.52; the print is also 2026-10-19.

The 10-year nominal yield at 5.15, contribution 4.8875 points, at the 98.88 percentile and up 0.06 from the previous 5.09. Its direction is set to neutral, so a high level of 5.15 is itself scored as elevated risk, with a risk score of 97.75.

Breadth above the 200-day average at 0.4, 62 of 155, contribution 4.5652 points, is the heaviest single item inside an equity_structure dimension of 66.66; in the same group new highs at 0.0385 mean 6 names and new lows at 0.0641 mean 10, so the extremes are still net negative.

supporting_signals.claim: Leadership has not broadened: semis_relative is 12.8878 percent behind and small_cap_relative 9.0256 percent behind, both on the 2026-10-20 close, which says the 16 rising rows come from a narrow theme rotation rather than a market-wide advance.

The AI hardware end is still being sold: Nvidia is down 5.2731 percent on the week, AMD down 11.6906 percent, Broadcom down 6.4202 percent and Micron down 5.9925 percent, and a dense day of announcements — simulation up to 40 times faster, DGX Spark at 4999 US dollars, substrate capacity at 2.5 times — has not converted into price.

The trend dimension at 45.02 is only mildly weak: price versus the 200-day average at 5.9492 percent, the 52-week drawdown at 1.2887 percent and 3-month momentum at 2.8953 percent carry risk scores of 46.08, 36.44 and 50.66, none of them in a high band.
Credit and liquidity give no stress confirmation: investment grade OAS at 0.87, reverse repo at 0.227, SOFR at 3.87 and the Fed balance sheet at 6755639.0, none of them in a stressed band.

contradicting_signals.claim: The volatility dimension at 34.46 is the lowest of the six, VIX at 18.44 is below the previous 19.99 and realized volatility is 9.0226, so volatility did not confirm while the score rose; the two point opposite ways.

Crypto is bid: bitcoin at 83410 up 2.4079 percent, ether at 2460.79 up 3.22158 percent and SOL at 106.83 up 2.57985 percent, with bitcoin dominance at 0.595654, so speculative appetite has not contracted.

A-shares closed broadly higher: 9 of 11 up at a mean gain of 2.0922 percent, with 001309.SZ up 6.4951 percent and 688008.SH up 5.3583 percent, so Asian risk appetite does not agree with a high_risk reading of 61.15.
The late_cycle label itself is thin: the trigger is VIX at or above 18 and the actual 18.44 clears it by only 0.44, so one ordinary session can push it back to risk_on.

what_changed_today: The composite moved from 57.44 to 61.15, up 3.71 cross-session, and the level went from caution back to high_risk.
The regime label changed from risk_on to late_cycle on cross-asset 0.625 at or above 0.55 with VIX 18.44 at or above 18.
Cross_asset_confirmation rose from 0.375 to 0.625, worth 3.75 points at a 0.15 weight and the bulk of the 3.71; the other five dimensions moved by less than 0.06 combined.

The memory theme at 5.7396 percent is a single-session Asian reading: of an effective basket of 8, only 000660.KS up 5.8054 percent and 005930.KS up 5.6738 percent have a 2026-10-21 bar, so the published value is the mean of those two.

Consumer_electronics at 1.2794 percent and robotics at 0.0617 percent down share that form: the first holds only 1810.HK down 0.9608 percent and 2317.TW up 3.5197 percent, the second only 6861.T down 0.0618 percent.
The 2026-10-21 A-share close is a single-session base: 9 of 11 up at a mean gain of 2.0922 percent, with 001309.SZ up 6.4951 percent the strongest and 002156.SZ down 0.9146 percent the weakest.

Tesla rose 1.5351 percent on 2026-10-20 to close at 373.709991; SpaceX's third quarter with revenue growth of 161 percent and adjusted EBITDA growth of 306 percent left it up more than 8 percent in premarket, with a merger idea discussed in public.
Only two liquidity prints advanced overnight: reverse repo fell from 0.33 to 0.227, and breakevens at 2.31 and 2.35 moved to the 2026-10-20 vintage.
watch_next: META, T and TSLA report at 2026-10-21T12:00:00Z, with TSLA on a forecast of 0.4488, the only event today that lands directly on an asset in the fact layer.
Whether cross-asset holds 0.625: each lost signal cuts that dimension by 12.5 points and the composite by 1.875 points, so the 3.71 can be given back inside one session.
Whether the rates block advances past 2026-10-20: the 10-year at 5.15 and the 2-year at 4.77 still sit on 2026-10-19, and half of the macro dimension at 73.52 rests on those older prints.
Whether Nvidia converts the announcement flow into price: it closed at 216.470001, down 5.2731 percent on the week, while the substrate and packaging capacity news is a three-year commitment.
Whether Korean memory strength transmits to US memory: Micron at 896.070007, down 5.9925 percent on the week, is the most direct read on that chain.
Whether breadth leaves 0.4: 62 of 155 above the 200-day average with 10 new lows against 6 new highs is the group most in need of repair among the six dimensions.
GOOGL and MSFT report at 2026-10-28T12:00:00Z, the first earnings test of the Vera Rubin commercial story.

bull_case.title: Bull case: earnings carry the supply-chain story and the signal count rolls back
points: TSLA reports against a forecast of 0.4488, and a beat would stack on top of the Tesla-SpaceX merger optionality; it already rose 1.5351 percent yesterday.
Volatility at 34.46 is the lowest of the six and VIX 18.44 has already come down, so if cross-asset returns to 0.375 the composite gives back from 61.15 to 57.44, which is exactly 3.75 points.
Korean memory up 5.8054 and 5.6738 percent shows the memory upcycle is intact, leaving room for Micron at 896.070007 to repair a week in which it fell 5.9925 percent.
Breadth at 0.4 has room to repair: 62 of 155 above the 200-day average, and any broadening directly lowers an equity_structure dimension of 66.66.

base_case.title: Base case: a supply-chain rotation under a late_cycle label, with the score oscillating near 61
points: 16 rows rose at a mean gain of 0.9395 percent, but the semiconductor chain accounts for 5 of the 6 declining rows, which is rotation rather than a broad advance.
The composite at 61.15 sits between the 57.44 of 2026-10-20 and the 62.51 of 2026-10-16 and has not broken the upper edge.
Inside a confidence of 0.9153 the consistency component is only 0.7163, so the dimensions disagree and a single day's direction is not very persistent.
Commodity-driven signal flips can reverse within a session or two, and copper down 0.1827 percent with gold up 0.0459 percent is exactly that order of magnitude.

bear_case.title: Bear case: only the signal count is holding the score up, and neither breadth nor semis leadership supports it
points: Breadth at 0.4 with 10 new lows against 6 new highs says the 16 rising rows do not reach the single-stock level.
Semis_relative is 12.8878 percent behind and small_cap_relative 9.0256 percent behind, so leadership sits in a handful of themes.
If VIX prints above 18.44 the volatility dimension at 34.46 rises and late_cycle locks in rather than returning to risk_on.
AI hardware is still being repriced: AMD down 11.6906 percent on the week, Broadcom down 6.4202 percent, Micron down 5.9925 percent and Nvidia down 5.2731 percent.
